title: an adopted queue entry keeps the ask it was minted with, so the adaptive-fit fix could not reach it
evidence: cmd_ensure computes the ask from LIVE free memory, but when it adopts our own queued record it kept that record's PERSISTED vram_gb -- and gpu_scheduler.py's poll re-checks the persisted number at CLAIM time (read_queue -> job vram_gb, lines 830-855), not the ask the harness just computed. Measured live 2026-09-21: 09:01:09 the harness logged 'adaptive fit - free=13145MiB < full ask 21GiB, so asking 16GiB' and in the same tick 'adopting our own queued entry comfyui-1789992236-4075726-1', whose record asks 21.0GB -- so the entry stays refused for the whole of its life against the ~18.9GiB actually free once prx-tg-pixel-posttrain-v3 releases, is given up at the FIFO head, and is re-requested a whole render window later. Same class as render-ask-poisoned-by-occupancy (81e8c4a), which covered only the fresh-request path.

notes.note: 2026-09-21 13:5xZ ops-triage: FIXED in-repo (cb0f36d). New queued_job_vram_gb() reads a record's persisted ask and ask_exceeds() is a pure offline decision (answers 'no' on anything unreadable, so a parse bug can never cost us a FIFO place). cmd_ensure now retires an adopted own record and re-requests at the live ask ONLY when the persisted ask genuinely exceeds it; equal-or-smaller records keep their place. Verified with no GPU and no claim: bin/comfyui_harness_test.sh 18 assertions / 0 failures -- stale 21GiB record cancelled with reason 'ask 21.0GiB above the live-fit ask 16GiB' and re-requested at --vram 16, no --vram 21 request issued, fitting 16GiB record left queued with no request minted; decision table 21>16 / 16=16 / 15.5<16 / unreadable / 21.0>16 => 10001. Negative control: with the guard mutated out of a COPY of the harness, the stale record stays queued and no fresh request is issued (exactly the live defect) -- the new assertions fail. Policy unchanged: plan 13145 => 16GiB, 24564 => 21GiB, 8192 => 16GiB; tc_ops.py selftest 224 assertions / 0 failures. Live effect: our outstanding entry comfyui-1789992236-4075726-1 (21.0GB) is re-minted at 16GiB by the next tick's own code path -- no manual queue surgery performed.
